title: [PDF] Social sciences suffer from severe publication bias
abstract: WT.mc_id=TWT_NatureNews Print NATURE | NEWS Social sciences suffer from severe publication bias Survey finds that ‘null results’ rarely see the light of the day. Researchers at Stanford University in California have now measured the extent of the problem, finding that most null results in a sample of social-science studies were never published.
